mapper.select: SELECT CAST(a.article_count AS CHAR) AS article_count, CAST(c.category_count AS CHAR) AS category_count, CAST(t.tag_count AS CHAR) AS tag_count, CAST(pv.page_view_count AS CHAR) AS page_view_count, CAST(pv.today_page_view_count AS CHAR) AS today_page_view_count, CAST(pv.visitor_count AS CHAR) AS visitor_count FROM ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS article_count FROM blog_article a WHERE ) a CROSS JOIN ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS category_count FROM blog_category WHERE status = 1 ) c CROSS JOIN ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS tag_count FROM blog_tag ) t CROSS JOIN ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS page_view_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN view_time >= #{today} AND view_time < #{tomorrow} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS today_page_view_count, COUNT(DISTINCT visitor_id) AS visitor_count FROM blog_page_view WHERE site_code = 'blog' ) pv

SELECT CAST(pv.page_view_count AS CHAR) AS page_view_count, CAST(pv.visitor_count AS CHAR) AS visitor_count, CAST(nv.new_visitor_count AS CHAR) AS new_visitor_count, CAST(art.article_count AS CHAR) AS article_count, CAST(art.published_article_count AS CHAR) AS published_article_count, CAST(cmt.comment_count AS CHAR) AS comment_count, CAST(msg.message_count AS CHAR) AS message_count, CAST(cmt.pending_comment_count AS CHAR) AS pending_comment_count, CAST(msg.pending_message_count AS CHAR) AS pending_message_count FROM ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS page_view_count, COUNT(DISTINCT v.visitor_id) AS visitor_count FROM blog_page_view v WHERE ) pv CROSS JOIN ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS new_visitor_count FROM blog_visitor x WHERE ) nv CROSS JOIN ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS article_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN a.status = 1 AND a.visibility = 1 AND a.publish_time IS NOT NULL AND a.publish_time <= #{now} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS published_article_count FROM blog_article a WHERE a.deleted_at IS NULL ) art CROSS JOIN ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS comment_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pending_comment_count FROM blog_comment ) cmt CROSS JOIN ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS message_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pending_message_count FROM blog_message ) msg

SELECT DATE(v.view_time) AS date, CAST(COUNT(*) AS CHAR) AS page_view_count, CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT v.visitor_id) AS CHAR) AS visitor_count FROM blog_page_view v WHERE GROUP BY DATE(v.view_time) ORDER BY DATE(v.view_time)

SELECT DATE(x.first_visit_time) AS date, CAST(COUNT(*) AS CHAR) AS new_visitor_count, '0' AS cumulative_new_visitor_count FROM blog_visitor x WHERE GROUP BY DATE(x.first_visit_time) ORDER BY DATE(x.first_visit_time)

SELECT x.province, CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT x.visitor_id) AS CHAR) AS visitor_count FROM blog_visitor x JOIN blog_page_view v ON v.visitor_id = x.visitor_id WHERE GROUP BY x.province ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT x.visitor_id) DESC, x.province ASC

SELECT CASE WHEN v.referer IS NULL OR v.referer = '' THEN '' ELSE SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(v.referer, '://', -1), '/', 1) END AS source, CAST(COUNT(*) AS CHAR) AS page_view_count, CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT v.visitor_id) AS CHAR) AS visitor_count FROM blog_page_view v WHERE GROUP BY source ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, source ASC LIMIT #{limit}
